tasks.description: Project scaffolding: package.json (ESM, Node 22 engine, scripts start/test/build via node --check and node --test) and README.md documenting install/start/test and limitations.
Pure conversion & validation module convert.js: export convert(value, from, to) and validate units/types/absolute-zero (FR3, FR4). No HTTP dependency (NFR1).

HTTP layer: app.js exports createServer/request handler for GET / (HTML), POST /api/convert (FR2, FR4), GET /health (FR5); index.js starts on process.env.PORT; public/index.html provides the browser form (FR1).
Unit tests for pure logic: convert.test.js covering C/F/K conversions, same-unit, negative values, booleans, unsupported units, absolute-zero boundaries (FR3, FR4 boundary).

Integration tests for HTTP endpoints: api.test.js starting server on ephemeral port; asserts GET / HTML, POST /api/convert 200 & 400 cases (missing/nonnumeric/below-zero/malformed JSON), GET /health (FR1, FR2, FR4, FR5).

assumptions: Use ESM ('type': 'module') with no external runtime or dev dependencies; rely on Node 22 built-in node:test runner so npm install is trivial.
npm run build performs syntax checking via 'node --check' on source files since there is no compilation step.
Public HTML page is a static file served from public/index.html for GET /.
Absolute-zero boundaries: -273.15 C, -459.67 F, 0 K, allowing insignificant floating-point error per FR4.
